A study's species profile as a TreeSummarizedExperiment

Source: R/studies.R
cmgd_species_tse.Rd

Builds a species x samples TreeSummarizedExperiment from the study's metaphlan_species.tsv.gz (relative abundance in percent, main MetaPhlAn pass, all reads) with a sparse relative_abundance assay and the study's qc.tsv as colData. Every sample in qc.tsv is a column; a sample with no species rows is all zero.

Usage

cmgd_species_tse(rel, study, cache = cmgd_cache_dir())

Arguments

rel

A release from cmgd_release().

study

Study name, for example "ZellerG_2014".

cache

Cache directory.

Value

A TreeSummarizedExperiment.

Examples

rel <- cmgd_release("cmgd_mpa4.2-2.3.0", release = "2026-10-16")
tse <- cmgd_species_tse(rel, "ZellerG_2014", cache = tempdir())
